autoAdjustOverflow.zh-CN: 浮层被遮挡时是否自动调整方向。
autoAdjustOverflow.en-US: Whether to flip the popup automatically when it is clipped.

autoFocus.zh-CN: 挂载后将焦点交给输入框，透传给输入框的 `autoFocus`。
autoFocus.en-US: Focuses the input once mounted; passed through to the input's `autoFocus`.

className.en-US: Class name of the root element.

clearIcon.zh-CN: 自定义清除图标，`showClear` 为 `true` 时有效。
clearIcon.en-US: Custom clear icon; effective when `showClear` is `true`.

defaultOpen.zh-CN: 非受控时面板是否默认打开。
defaultOpen.en-US: Whether the panel is open by default when uncontrolled.

defaultValue.zh-CN: 非受控时的初始时间，形态同 `value`；`type` 为 `timeRange` 时为数组。
defaultValue.en-US: Initial time when uncontrolled, in the same forms as `value`; an array when `type` is `timeRange`.

disabledHours.zh-CN: 返回禁止选择的小时数组。
disabledHours.en-US: Returns the hours that cannot be selected.

disabledMinutes.zh-CN: 按所选小时返回禁止选择的分钟数组。
disabledMinutes.en-US: Returns the minutes that cannot be selected for the selected hour.

disabledSeconds.zh-CN: 按所选小时和分钟返回禁止选择的秒数组。
disabledSeconds.en-US: Returns the seconds that cannot be selected for the selected hour and minute.

disabledTime.zh-CN: 仅范围模式生效：按 `value` 与 `panelType`（`left` 或 `right`）返回左右面板各自的规则；`value` 没有值时为空数组，只含一个时间时长度为 1，未选的一侧为 `undefined`。返回的 `disabledHours` 等覆盖顶层同名属性，未返回的回退到顶层，关闭顶层规则需返回空数组的函数；单选模式下忽略。
disabledTime.en-US: Range mode only: returns the rules of each panel from `value` and `panelType` (`left` or `right`); `value` is an empty array with no value, length 1 with a single time, and `undefined` on the unpicked side. A returned `disabledHours` and the like overrides the top-level prop of the same name, one left out falls back to it, and a function returning `[]` switches off a top-level rule for that panel; ignored in single mode.

focusOnOpen.zh-CN: 挂载后让输入框获得焦点并选中内容，同时打开面板。
focusOnOpen.en-US: Focuses the input and selects its content once mounted, which opens the panel.

format.zh-CN: 展示的时间格式，遵循 date-fns 的 format。未设置时，`use12Hours` 为 `true` 取 `a h:mm:ss`，否则取 `HH:mm:ss`。
format.en-US: Display format, following date-fns format. Defaults to `a h:mm:ss` with `use12Hours`, else `HH:mm:ss`.

hideDisabledOptions.en-US: Hides the options that cannot be selected.

hourStep.zh-CN: 小时选项的间隔，必须是正整数，未设置时为 1。
hourStep.en-US: Interval of the hour options; a positive integer, 1 when unset.

inputReadOnly.zh-CN: 输入框只读，避免在移动设备上打开虚拟键盘；只读时清除按钮仍可用。
inputReadOnly.en-US: Makes the input read-only, which avoids opening the virtual keyboard on mobile devices; the clear button stays usable.

inputStyle.zh-CN: 输入框的样式，对象的键用 camelCase。
inputStyle.en-US: Style of the input; an object with camelCase keys.

insetLabel.zh-CN: 输入框内部的前缀标签，显示在输入框内。
insetLabel.en-US: Prefix label shown inside the input.

insetLabelId.en-US: `id` of the `insetLabel`, referenced through `aria-labelledby` and similar attributes.

minuteStep.zh-CN: 分钟选项的间隔，必须是正整数，未设置时为 1。
minuteStep.en-US: Interval of the minute options; a positive integer, 1 when unset.

open.zh-CN: 面板是否打开，受控属性；`undefined` 视为非受控。
open.en-US: Whether the panel is open; a controlled property, and `undefined` means uncontrolled.

panelFooter.zh-CN: 面板底部的内容。范围模式下可传数组，第 `i` 项用于第 `i` 个面板。
panelFooter.en-US: Content below the panel. In range mode an array, whose item `i` is used for panel `i`.

panelHeader.zh-CN: 面板头部的内容。范围模式下可传数组，第 `i` 项用于第 `i` 个面板；未设置时范围模式显示语言包中的起止文案。
panelHeader.en-US: Content above the panel. In range mode an array, whose item `i` is used for panel `i`; when unset, range mode shows the begin and end locale texts.

panels.zh-CN: 仅范围模式：第 `i` 项同时作为第 `i` 个面板的头部和底部，优先于 `panelHeader` 与 `panelFooter`。单选模式下忽略。
panels.en-US: Range mode only: item `i` is both the header and the footer of panel `i`, taking precedence over `panelHeader` and `panelFooter`. Ignored in single mode.

placeholder.zh-CN: 没有值时显示的提示，默认取语言包中对应 `type` 的文案。
placeholder.en-US: Hint shown without a value; defaults to the locale text of `type`.

popupStyle.zh-CN: 弹出层的样式，对象的键用 camelCase。
popupStyle.en-US: Style of the popup; an object with camelCase keys.

position.zh-CN: 浮层位置。未设置时，`type` 为 `timeRange` 取 `bottom`，为 `time` 取 `bottomLeft`；RTL 方向下取 `bottomRight`。
position.en-US: Popup position. Unset, it is `bottom` for `timeRange` and `bottomLeft` for `time`; `bottomRight` under RTL.

preventScroll.zh-CN: 聚焦时是否阻止浏览器滚动文档，直接作为 `focus()` 的 `preventScroll` 选项，作用于组件内部的聚焦调用。
preventScroll.en-US: Whether focusing prevents the browser from scrolling the document; passed directly as the `preventScroll` option of `focus()`, for the focus calls inside the component.

rangeSeparator.en-US: Separator between the two times of a range.

scrollItemProps.zh-CN: 传给各列的属性，只支持 `cycled`、`mode`、`motion`、`transform`，含义同 ScrollList 的 ScrollItem。
scrollItemProps.en-US: Props passed to the columns; only `cycled`, `mode`, `motion` and `transform`, as on the ScrollItem of ScrollList.

secondStep.zh-CN: 秒选项的间隔，必须是正整数，未设置时为 1。
secondStep.en-US: Interval of the second options; a positive integer, 1 when unset.

showClear.en-US: Whether to show the clear button.

size.zh-CN: 输入框的大小，可选 `large`、`default` 或 `small`。

stopPropagation.zh-CN: 是否阻止弹出层上的点击事件冒泡。
stopPropagation.en-US: Whether to stop click events on the popup from bubbling.

timeZone.zh-CN: 时区：数字为相对 UTC 的小时偏移，字符串为 IANA 时区名；未设置时取 ConfigProvider 的 `timeZone`。
timeZone.en-US: Time zone: a number is the hour offset from UTC, a string is an IANA time zone name; defaults to the `timeZone` of ConfigProvider.

triggerRender.zh-CN: 自定义触发器的渲染函数。入参含 `disabled`、`placeholder`、`value`（`Date` 数组，未选的一侧为 `undefined`）、`inputValue`、`componentProps`（TimePicker 的属性，不含 `ref`）和 `onChange`（更新输入框文本，效果同键入）。
triggerRender.en-US: Renders a custom trigger. The argument has `disabled`, `placeholder`, `value` (an array of `Date`, the unpicked side `undefined`), `inputValue`, `componentProps` (the props of the TimePicker, without `ref`) and `onChange` (updates the input text, as typing would).

type.zh-CN: 选择类型，`time` 为单个时间，`timeRange` 为时间范围。
type.en-US: Selection type: `time` for a single time, `timeRange` for a time range.

use12Hours.zh-CN: 使用 12 小时制，为 `true` 时 `format` 默认为 `a h:mm:ss`。
use12Hours.en-US: Uses the 12-hour clock; with `true`, `format` defaults to `a h:mm:ss`.

validateStatus.zh-CN: 校验状态，仅影响展示样式。
validateStatus.en-US: Validation status, which only affects the display style.

value.zh-CN: 当前时间，可为 `Date`、时间戳或字符串；`type` 为 `timeRange` 时为数组。`null` 是受控的空值，`undefined` 视为非受控。
value.en-US: Current time, as a `Date`, a timestamp or a string; an array when `type` is `timeRange`. `null` is a controlled empty value, and `undefined` means uncontrolled.

onBlur.zh-CN: 点击外部关闭面板时的回调，参数为该次 mousedown 的原生事件。
onBlur.en-US: Callback when a click outside closes the panel, with the native event of that mousedown.

onChange.zh-CN: 时间变化的回调。`type` 为 `time` 时参数为 `(Date, 格式化字符串)`，为 `timeRange` 时两者都是数组。
onChange.en-US: Callback when the time changes. With `type` `time` it gets `(Date, formatted string)`; with `timeRange` both are arrays.

onFocus.zh-CN: 输入框获得焦点时的回调。
onFocus.en-US: Callback when the input gains focus.

onOpenChange.zh-CN: 面板打开或关闭时的回调，参数为是否打开。
onOpenChange.en-US: Callback when the panel opens or closes, with whether it is open.

ref.zh-CN: 组件句柄的引用，方法见 Methods 表。
ref.en-US: Reference to the component handle; its methods are listed under Methods.

focus.zh-CN: 聚焦输入框，聚焦会打开面板；`preventScroll` 生效。
focus.en-US: Focuses the input, which opens the panel; `preventScroll` applies.
